items.name: Integral / Square attack (ronde tereduksi)
refs: Daemen, Knudsen, Rijmen — The Block Cipher Square, FSE 1997
Ferguson et al. — Improved Cryptanalysis of Rijndael, FSE 2000

items.name: Exhaustive key search (brute force)
refs: Batas generik |K| = 2^128; SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev.5 Tabel 2

items.name: Biclique cryptanalysis (full AES-128)
refs: Bogdanov, Khovratovich, Rechberger — Biclique Cryptanalysis of the Full AES, ASIACRYPT 2011

items.name: Differential cryptanalysis (batas wide-trail)
refs: Biham & Shamir, CRYPTO 1990 / J. Cryptology 1991
Daemen & Rijmen — The Design of Rijndael, Springer 2002 (wide trail strategy)

items.name: Linear cryptanalysis (batas wide-trail)
refs: Matsui, EUROCRYPT 1993
Daemen & Rijmen — The Design of Rijndael, 2002

items.name: Impossible differential / meet-in-the-middle (7 ronde AES-128)
refs: Lu, Dunkelman, Keller, Kim — New impossible differential attacks on AES, INDOCRYPT 2008
Derbez, Fouque, Jean — MITM attacks on AES, EUROCRYPT 2013

items.name: Nonce/counter reuse pada mode CTR/GCM
refs: SP 800-38A App. B (keunikan counter block)
Joux — Authentication failures in NIST version of GCM (forbidden attack), 2006

items.name: Counter overflow / wrap-around (keystream berulang)
items.status: praktis (bila > 256 GiB per nonce pada ChaCha20 RFC 8439)
refs: RFC 8439 §2.4 (counter 32-bit ⇒ maks 2^32 blok × 64 byte)

items.name: Perbandingan tidak constant-time (memcmp pada tag/MAC/padding)
refs: Lawson — Timing attack in Google Keyczar, 2009
ISO/IEC 17825

items.name: Buffer over-read/overflow (memory safety)
refs: NVD CVE-2014-0160 (Heartbleed, OpenSSL)

items.name: Material kunci tidak di-zeroize (sisa di memori / cold boot)
refs: Halderman et al. — Lest We Remember: Cold Boot Attacks, USENIX Security 2008
ISO/IEC 19790 §7.9 (zeroisation)

items.name: Cache-timing pada implementasi berbasis tabel (T-table / S-box lookup)
refs: Bernstein — Cache-timing attacks on AES, 2005
Osvik, Shamir, Tromer — Cache Attacks and Countermeasures: the Case of AES, CT-RSA 2006

items.name: RNG lemah saat pembangkitan kunci
refs: CVE-2008-0166 (Debian OpenSSL, ruang kunci 2^15)
Heninger et al., USENIX Security 2012

items.name: Transient execution (Spectre)
refs: Kocher et al. — Spectre Attacks, IEEE S&P 2019

items.name: Frequency-scaling side-channel (Hertzbleed)
refs: Wang et al. — Hertzbleed, USENIX Security 2022
